name: Mukhyamantri Bijli Bill Bakaya Maaf Samadhan Scheme
benefit: - **Waiver of Outstanding Dues:** Complete waiver of surcharge amount and 50% waiver of the principal outstanding amount as of the date of implementation of the scheme.  - **Benefit to Consumers:** The entire surcharge and 50% of the principal amount are borne by the concerned distribution companies.  - **State Government Support:** The remaining 50% of the principal amount is borne by the State G
_eligibility_text: The applicant must be a registered worker under the "Mukhyamantri Mazdoor Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana". The applicant must be a construction worker or a Below Poverty Line (BPL) consumer.
